title: Manual Generation Mode + UI/UX & Functional Fixes for Leave Application Generator

requirements.text: Add a 'Create Application' button below the input fields in the Input Section of the Leave Application page. This button must always be rendered regardless of whether any inputs are filled. Application generation must only trigger when this button is explicitly clicked. Remove any reactive/live generation logic that fires while the user is typing (e.g., useEffect or derived state that auto-updates the output on input change).

quotes: Add a 'Create Application' button below the input fields in the Input Section.
Application generation must only occur when this button is clicked.
Disable automatic live generation while typing.

acceptanceCriteria: 'Create Application' button is rendered below all input fields at all times
No output is generated or updated while the user types in any input field
Clicking the 'Create Application' button triggers the letter/application generation
Button remains visible when all fields are empty

requirements.text: In the Output Section of the Leave Application page, statically render the following three buttons at all times: 'Copy to Clipboard', 'Download as PDF', and 'Clear Output' (new button). Remove all conditional rendering logic that shows these buttons only when output exists. These buttons must be visible when no input has been entered, when no application has been generated, and when the output preview is empty.

quotes: ensure the following three buttons are always visible by default
These buttons must remain visible even when: No input is entered, No application is generated, Output preview is empty
Remove any conditional rendering logic such as: IF output exists THEN show buttons
Buttons must be statically rendered at all times.

acceptanceCriteria: 'Copy to Clipboard', 'Download as PDF', and 'Clear Output' buttons are all visible on page load before any input is entered
Buttons are visible when the output preview area is empty
No conditional check on output state controls button visibility
All three buttons are rendered in the Output Section in a consistent layout

requirements.text: Implement the 'Clear Output' button functionality in the Output Section. On click: immediately clear the generated application preview text, reset the output state to empty, and keep all three Output Section buttons ('Copy to Clipboard', 'Download as PDF', 'Clear Output') visible. Do not reload or navigate the page when clearing output.

quotes: On click: Instantly clear the generated application preview, Reset output state, Keep all three buttons visible
Do not reload the page on clearing output.

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking 'Clear Output' clears the preview text/content immediately without page reload
Output state is reset to empty/null after clicking
All three Output Section buttons remain visible after clearing
No browser navigation or page refresh occurs on clear

requirements.text: Fix the date picker bug on the Leave Application page where users cannot navigate to or select dates beyond February. Remove any unintended maxDate restriction or month-range limit that prevents navigating past February. Ensure full month navigation (all 12 months), correct date highlighting, and valid date selection for all months of the year including future dates.

quotes: Fix the 'Absent Since Date' calendar issue where users cannot select dates beyond February.
Enable full month navigation in the date picker.
Remove any unintended maxDate or month restriction.
Ensure correct date highlighting and selection for all months of the year.
The calendar must function properly for both single date and date range selection.

acceptanceCriteria: User can navigate forward past February to March and all subsequent months
User can select dates in any month of the year including future months
No maxDate or restrictive month cap is applied to the calendar
Date highlighting correctly reflects the selected date in any month
Date range selection (start and end date) works correctly across all months

requirements.text: Fix language consistency for the Leave Application Generator: when Urdu or Arabic is selected as the output language, ensure the entire application content (body, subject line, date strings, salutation, signature, and all labels) is generated exclusively in that language with no English words or phrases mixed in. Automatically apply RTL (right-to-left) text direction and alignment to the entire output preview and PDF when Urdu or Arabic is selected.

quotes: If Urdu or Arabic is selected as the output language: Ensure the entire application content is generated in that language
Do not allow any English words or phrases in the output
Apply RTL (Right-to-Left) alignment automatically for these languages

acceptanceCriteria: When Urdu is selected, the full letter output contains no English text
When Arabic is selected, the full letter output contains no English text
RTL text direction (dir='rtl', text-align: right) is applied to the output preview when Urdu or Arabic is selected
RTL direction is also applied to the PDF export for Urdu and Arabic
All placeholders, dates, and labels are translated/formatted in the selected language

requirements.text: Optimize the PDF export of the Leave Application to match the on-screen preview exactly. Ensure consistent line spacing, intact paragraph alignment, and no extra blank lines or spaces inserted between lines in the PDF output. The PDF layout must be a faithful reproduction of the preview.

quotes: Ensure that the downloaded PDF: Matches the on-screen preview exactly
Maintains consistent line spacing
Keeps paragraph alignment intact
Avoids extra blank spaces between lines

acceptanceCriteria: Downloaded PDF text layout matches the on-screen preview visually
No extra blank lines appear between paragraphs in the PDF
Line spacing in the PDF is consistent and matches the preview
Paragraph alignment (left, right, or RTL) is preserved in the PDF

constraints: Do not reload the page when clearing output
Do not alter the backend schema or Motoko actor
Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
All button visibility changes must use static rendering, not conditional rendering based on output state
nonGoals: Adding new language translations beyond fixing Urdu and Arabic consistency
Changing the overall design theme or color scheme
Modifying the Study Planner, Notes Cleaner, Resume Builder, or Assignment Format pages
Adding authentication or user accounts to the Leave Application page
